checks: builder entry and exit patched to the break hooks
stopped: PAGE keeps its ordinary path, no break
entry hook: sequencer steps remapped inside the track, preview/precompute untouched, frame and registers as stock
exit hook: lock buffer stored, message returned; break locks and ratchets only on the sequencer path
PAGE during playback: press starts a fresh break, repeats held, release ends it and the pattern plays as written
limitations: Hooks run on the packaged code with synthetic frames and patterns; the stock sequencer interrupt, dispatcher and audio are not executed together; timing/latency (up to one step) not measured.
